name: Repeated-Coordinate Cubes
definition: For each integer $n\ge1$, let $W_n=\{0,1\}^{n-1}$ (containing the empty word when $n=1$). On the disjoint domain $X_n=\{x_2,\ldots,x_n\}\sqcup\{z_w:w\in W_n\}$, the **repeated-coordinate cube** is $\mathcal R_n=\{h_v:v=(v_1,\ldots,v_n)\in\{0,1\}^n\}$, where $h_v(x_j)=v_j$ for $2\le j\le n$ and $h_v(z_w)=v_1$ for every $w\in W_n$. Thus only the first cube coordinate is repeated, in $2^{n-1}$ identical copies. Every domain coordinate takes both labels on the class.
comments: A local active-coordinate witness separating subset and no-clashing teaching from antichain number by unbounded ratios. Repeated columns must not be quotiented out when computing antichain number; the specified domain is part of this parameter's input.
